issues.detail: The skill contains verbose explanations that may distract from core instructions.

scenarios.name: nextjs-social-login-pkce
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers more rubric items (PKCE, state/nonce, cookie handling) than Response A, though it still omits token exchange, ID‑token validation, GitHub profile fetch, and refresh‑token rotation.

scenarios.name: api-jwt-validation
scenarios.rationale: Response B explicitly fetches the JWKS via the discovery endpoint, verifies all required claims, checks scope, and handles 401/403, whereas Response A uses a hard‑coded JWKS URL and separates scope checking into a separate helper.

scenarios.name: spa-logout-token-revocation
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers revocation, id_token_hint, post_logout_redirect_uri, and uses the end_session_endpoint, while Response A omits id_token_hint, post_logout_redirect_uri, and does not use the end_session_endpoint, making B more complete.
